design: New seeded faults in two previously repaired four-module programs. B = TIDE complete body, F = TIDE function fragment, P = CPython same fragment option. Three blocks per fault, opposite balanced Latin squares. Serial ephemeral CLI calls, same model/effort/service. Timed before failed public check through application and first passing public verification. Max three attempts. Separate fresh public and holdout replay. Gross tokens from turn.completed input+output, cached included. Primary: within-block paired median difference F minus P and F minus B, plus wins. Frozen before model runs.
cases: For each family prepend extra_first to original public cases, then retain only the first occurrence of each distinct input across public then holdout. Retain original expected outputs; all initial and canonical outputs checked for language parity. Model receives contract, first failed result, alphabetically ordered reachable sources and edit instructions. Retry gets previous reply and public feedback only. For hidden checks prepend extra_hidden before deduplication.

dispatch.contract: Select routes for a fast profile (minimize delay, then watts) and a green profile (minimize watts, then delay). Full ties retain the earliest input. Return the selected IDs or zero for each if empty. Route IDs are distinct positive integers. Delay and watts are small nonnegative integers.

canonical.tide/routes.tide:
record Route
id:i delay:i watts:i

initial routes:*{Route} > {Route}
case (at routes 0) (make Route id 0 delay 0 watts 0) head head
canonical.python/routes.py:
def initial(routes):
    return routes[0] if routes else {"id": 0, "delay": 0, "watts": 0}
canonical.tide/interactive.tide:
use routes

interactive routes:*{Route} > i
let chosen fold routes (initial routes) best row next
  if (or (< (get delay next) (get delay best)) (and (eq (get delay next) (get delay best)) (< (get watts next) (get watts best)))) next best
get id chosen
canonical.tide/eco.tide:
use routes

eco routes:*{Route} > i
let chosen fold routes (initial routes) best row next
  if (or (< (get watts next) (get watts best)) (and (eq (get watts next) (get watts best)) (< (get delay next) (get delay best)))) next best
get id chosen
canonical.tide/summary.tide:
use eco

use interactive

record Choice
fast:i green:i

choose routes:*{Route} > {Choice}
make Choice fast (interactive routes) green (eco routes)

main batches:**{Route} > *{Choice}
fold batches (list {Choice} 0) acc row batch append acc (choose batch)

press.contract: Report sheets needed for colour and mono printing. A sheet holds four colour pages or three mono pages. For each job, runs of the same kind share sheets. Separate jobs and kinds cannot share them. Empty jobs or runs consume no sheets. Counts are small nonnegative integers.

canonical.tide/job.tide:
record Job
colour:*i mono:*i

pages runs:*i > i
fold runs 0 total row n + total n

sheets n:i capacity:i > i
div (+ n (- capacity 1)) capacity
canonical.tide/colour.tide:
use job

colour_total jobs:*{Job} > i
fold jobs 0 total row job + total (sheets (pages (get colour job)) 4)
canonical.tide/mono.tide:
use job

mono_total jobs:*{Job} > i
fold jobs 0 total row job
  + total (sheets (pages (get mono job)) 3)
canonical.tide/summary.tide:
use colour

use mono

record Stock
colour_sheets:i mono_sheets:i

stock jobs:*{Job} > {Stock}
make Stock colour_sheets (colour_total jobs) mono_sheets (mono_total jobs)

main batches:**{Job} > *{Stock}
fold batches (list {Stock} 0) acc row jobs append acc (stock jobs)
